mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods following sustained increases in HOUST, or HOUST growth does not correlate with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a month signals an easing monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent easing.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO growth does not correlate with GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it signals a strong labor market and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month, it signals robust economic demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with robust economic demand.
